escalations_pending_on_4076.topic: Narrative dedup is string-matching prose, not comparing structured facts
escalations_pending_on_4076.summary: Design-level pattern observation, backed by 4 concrete live-reproduced PRs from today (#5205, #5208, #5209, #5216) all sharing the same root shape: a dedup/comparison flag implemented as .includes(<fixed literal string>) against a SIBLING section's rendered prose, which silently breaks whenever either side's wording changes. Confirmed the same brittle pattern remains live today in buildIntelSections (play-brief-intel.ts ~line 1751) for stopAdviceAlreadyNoted/captureAlreadyNoted -- both currently single-phrasing, will break the same way #5216 did the moment their source branch grows a second phrasing. Proposed direction (not pushed unilaterally, flagged for a second opinion given the refactor size): a shared structured-fact registry (stable keys, not string matches) instead of re-deriving facts by scanning sibling prose. First design-level escalation to #4076 this session -- offered to scope/take it or split with whoever's deepest in the file.
